prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high fidelity concept image for CREW, a real terminal-only collaborative workspace for trusted humans and AI. Wide landscape straight-on screenshot, crisp monospaced typography, dark charcoal background, flat terminal cells, minimal ASCII/Unicode borders, realistic terminal UI, no desktop window chrome, no glossy dashboard or avatars. Top shows shared tabs "1 project", "2 server". Main left 75% is tiled work panes: upper left is exactly one terminal belonging to Tab Agent showing a submitted Bash script in a boxed execution view with current command highlighted, and command output below. Upper right is a Pane Agent showing source context and green/red file diff in the MAIN work area. Lower pane is a human shell. Within the Pane Agent pane a narrow RIGHT agent CLI area shows conversation and tool-call summary above a bottom input prompt. A page-level rightmost column is Tab Agent's CLI transcript with tool-call summaries and bottom conversation input. Detailed scripts and file diffs belong to main work areas, not transcript columns. Colored existing borders indicate operators (mint human xm71, amber AI) on top/left/bottom and observers (blue lin) on right edge; an unused pane uses white border. Small explicit labels, no ownership, admin, permissions, invites, or transfer controls. Bottom status bar reads "TAB NAV | i terminal | a agent | A toggle | pending 1" and identifies current observers/operator. Emphasize coherent spacing and readable information density. This is a design exploration, not a marketing poster. Title small "CREW — shared workspace".

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a landscape concept comparison board for terminal-only CREW, showing two medium-width terminal screenshots side by side, consistent dark charcoal flat terminal aesthetics, crisp monospaced type, no browser chrome, no decorative perspective or people. Left screenshot labeled "PUBLIC / LIVE": shared pane grid, exactly one Tab Agent terminal, one subagent pane, colored borders indicating active operators and blue right borders for observers. Narrow screen agent CLI transcript panel overlays the terminal area rather than squeezing both side by side. Agent CLI combines conversation and tool-call summaries with fixed input prompt below. Behind overlay the main terminal work area contains a Bash script execution display with current command highlight; closing overlay would reveal it. Bottom bar "TAB NAV | i terminal | a agent | A toggle". Right screenshot labeled "PRIVATE / REVIEW": the same pane viewed by another connection, personal history view showing earlier file diff and Bash output, clear "REVIEW" mode indicator and "q return" hint. Review does not change left public live view or pause AI; annotate succinctly underneath "Shared layout. Independent navigation. Private history." and "One human operation slot per pane." Include small mode-flow strip below screenshots "SESSION NAV → i → TAB NAV → i TERMINAL / a AGENT" and "prefix + q → return". AI can execute while a human talks; entering terminal input pauses the corresponding AI. No owners or permission models, no traditional graphical IDE tabs inside panes. Focus on terminal UI concept readability and overlay behavior, not an architecture infographic.
